CODE
Art. 2.3.64. 
Authorised additions 
Spouses who opt for the separation of property regime  may add to that regime all clauses compatible with that regime.   
In particular, they may add clauses concerning the administration of proof, between them, of the exclusive right of ownership, concerning proof of claims that one may invoke against the other, as well as clauses specifying any joint ownership or patrimony by appropriation that may exist between them.
They may also adopt clauses designed to achieve a reconciliation of their assets and liabilities, in particular by adding a clause of participation aux acquts.
Articles 2.3.57 to 2.3.60 apply by analogy.
Spouses who have adopted a clause de participation aux acquts are subject to articles 2.3.65 to 2.3.77. The original assets, the final assets, the participation claim and the payment thereof are defined in accordance with these articles.
The spouses may, in their matrimonial agreement, derogate from the provisions of paragraph 1 and agree themselves on the participation mass, the participation key, the time of participation and the terms of participation.
The notary explicitly mentions in the matrimonial agreement that he has drawn the attention of each of the spouses to the legal consequences of adopting or not adopting a clause of participation in acquests.
